name: Air Fryer Cheesy Crab Stuffed Mushrooms with Artichokes & Sun-Dried Tomatoes

ingredients.name: dungeness crab cluster (pre-cooked), thawed if frozen

instructions.primary_message: Crack crab shells, legs, and claws, then pick out the crabmeat (you should have about ¾-cup loosely packed crabmeat). Gently break the crabmeat into bite-sized pieces, picking out any small pieces of shell that may have been missed. Place in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (8 oz) dungeness crab cluster (pre-cooked), thawed if frozen

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the crabmeat.
Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, setting aside a small handful for serving.
Drain and roughly chop artichoke hearts and sun-dried tomatoes. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated
4 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed

instructions.primary_message: Crumble goat cheese into the bowl. Add Parmesan, bread crumbs, and spices, then mash with a fork or the back of a spoon to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (4 oz) log goat cheese
½ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded
¼ cup panko bread crumbs
1 tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp crushed red pepper
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and remove stems from mushrooms.
Place mushrooms on a large plate, arranging them cap-side down. Divide filling between mushrooms, gently pressing it into each cavity.

Transfer stuffed mushrooms to the air fryer basket, spacing them at least ½-inch apart. Lightly coat with cooking spray. (Work in batches, if necessary, to accommodate the size of your air fryer basket.)
Insert basket into air fryer and set temperature to 350°F. Cook until stuffed mushrooms are tender and filling is warmed through, 8-10 minutes. Remove from air fryer and set aside to cool slightly.
To serve, arrange stuffed mushrooms on a platter and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Enjoy!

missing: dungeness crab cluster (pre-cooked), thawed if frozen
